check_cuda_available: check if CUDA is available on the current system using torch.cuda.is_available
check_rocm_pytorch: check if the current PyTorch installation is built with ROCm support
get_cuda_home_path: get the CUDA or ROCM home directory path from the torch build extension config
get_torch_build_config: get and display the current PyTorch build configuration and compiler info
use_syncbatchnorm_wrapper: use the SyncBatchNorm wrapper class that handles input dimension checks across PyTorch and Parrots
